steps.text: Dressing first: oil (6/8 g, olive — dressing and finishing only), the juice of a whole lime, 1 tsp chilli flakes, ½ tsp cumin, salt. Shake it.
Sweetcorn (40/55 g) into a dry pan on high, 2 minutes, until it blisters. Out.
Sunday's chicken (110/145 g — 255 g total, of the ~760 g roast batch) sliced and tossed in HALF the dressing in the warm pan — 30 seconds off the heat is enough to wake the spice up.
Black beans (110/145 g), tomato (90/110 g), red onion (30/40 g), the corn and shredded sweetheart cabbage (70/80 g) into a bowl with the rest of the dressing.
Chicken over. Salsa (50/60 g) and avocado (40/55 g) last.

why: Dress the chicken separately, and warm. Cold roast chicken tossed straight into a cold salad tastes like leftovers; thirty seconds in a warm pan with lime and chilli on it tastes like it was cooked for this.
notes: D0-003: this dish's oil is entirely a raw dressing (whisked before any heat and used to dress, never poured into a hot pan) — stays olive_oil, unchanged, no rename.

D0-003: lettuce -> sweetheart_cabbage applied. This is a chopped bowl salad (beans, corn, diced onion/tomato) rather than whole/torn leaves, matching the substitution note's own 'the bowls' category — id and grams unchanged (70/80 g), macro impact negligible (~7-8 kcal/cover, cabbage's per100g runs slightly higher than lettuce's).
batchTakeG covers the roast-chicken take (110/145 g of the 760 g Sunday batch, second of three consumers — see prep-b.json for the full 755/760 g reconciliation).
